Introduction

Jang Jiho is a South Korean singer. He debuted on March 20, 2022 as the maknae of the boy group NINE.i.

Jiho was revealed to be one of the participants of the survival show "Boys Planet" on December 29, 2023. Unfortunately, he was eliminated in episode 5 after ranking 63rd place.
